blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on Thursday, Sept. 24, continued its search for eight individuals still missing after a passenger ferry fire off Coron, Palawan. The PCG said its BRP Cape Engaño (MRRV-4411) resumed search and retrieval operations near Bantac Island and Lagat Island in Coron to locate the remaining victims two weeks after the incident. Its Coast Guard Sub-Station Turda also joined maritime and foot patrols along Napuscod Island.
